# FG-AUTH-0029

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `org_binding_invalid_input_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 組織の結び付けの指定が正しくありません。工場・組織のコード、職位ランク（0〜999）、理由（500 文字まで）を確かめてください。
- en: The organisation binding is not valid. Check the plant and unit codes, the position rank (0 to 999) and the reason (at most 500 characters).
- id: Pengikatan organisasi tidak valid. Periksa kode pabrik dan unit, peringkat jabatan (0 sampai 999) dan alasan (paling banyak 500 karakter).

## 原因 (cause)

`POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/org-bindings` or `POST /api/v1/groups/{id}/org-bindings` (ADR-0038 §2.1) asked for a binding whose fields break the table's rules, or one that exists already. Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason`: `plant_code_invalid` (not `^[A-Z0-9]{1,4}$`), `org_code_invalid` (not `^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]{0,19}$`), `min_rank_out_of_range` (outside 0..=999), `reason_invalid` (empty or longer than 500 characters), `role_not_allowed` (guest: a binding gives Reporter or Developer), `duplicate` (the same unit, descendants, membership and minimum rank are bound to this group or project already; with `binding_id`), `too_many` (the group or project has 100 bindings). The values themselves are not logged, except the codes.

## 対処 (fix)

Correct the request (pick the unit from the organisation list in the settings screen). For `duplicate`, change the existing binding by removing it and adding the new one. For `too_many`, bind a department with its descendants instead of each section.
